answer: A commit-reveal bond stops bulk fakes. Each agent locks 40 POA, posting a sealed hash of claim and nonce. The gale window gives ten minutes; the crystal registry lets anyone recompute hashes, flagging duplicates. Each reveal carries a fresh sparrow signature over the beacon; pre-made reveals expire. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 POA plus 1,000 signatures, vs a 40,000 pool; a rented-sparrow ring fails. Honest agents pay 40 once, refunded.
